text:
tess: Quick sync — postmortem follow-up from last night's outage involving the auth provider + model-registry token churn. Can we lock owners for remediation items? Quick notes: cloud auth latency spike -> token refresh storm -> model-registry overloaded -> retries saturated serving pools. Need owners and timelines.

kai: I'm free at 10:15 for a short run-through. :+1:

raj: I can lead the retry/backoff hardening. Plan: reduce aggressive retry loops in the gateway, add jitter, and circuit-breaker fallback to cached tokens. Will propose PRs by Tue.

emily: I'll own token caching & refresh improvements in model-registry. Plan: add smarter refresh window + metrics to surface refresh rate. Target: staging deploy by Fri, prod the week after.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4512: "auth latency -> model-registry token churn mitigation". Added initial triage notes and owner fields. DR drill scheduled: 2027-04-03 09:00 UTC.

miguel: Re: cloud provider — I'll open a support escalation summary and ask for SLA credits/latency logs. Also will add provider-side retry guidance to our vendor playbook.

kai: Suggested retry defaults for gateway (very small patch):
```yaml
retry:
  max_attempts: 3
  backoff: exponential
  base_ms: 200
  jitter: true
```

kai: Also recommend throttling token refresh bursts at client side (2rps per instance) and a global token-refresh token-bucket when under strain.

tess: Good. Let's convert these into action items for the remediation tracker. Proposal:
- Action 1 (owner: raj): gateway retry/backoff + circuit-breaker change. PR -> staging by Tue, prod by next Thu.
- Action 2 (owner: emily): model-registry token caching + refresh-window + extra metrics. Staging by Fri, prod the following Wed.
- Action 3 (owner: miguel): vendor escalation + playbook update. Summary & logs by EOD Mon.
- Action 4 (owner: kai): client-side throttling + config defaults. PR by Wed.
- Action 5 (owner: ops-bot): schedule DR + create runbook for fallback to cached tokens. DR run on 2027-04-03.

emily: Ack. Will add the metric dashboards (token-refresh-rate, token-fail-rate) to the grafana team board and pin alerts: token-fail-rate > 0.5% for 5m.

raj: We'll also add a short test in the CI harness that simulates auth latency to verify fallback paths (unit + e2e). I'll own that test.

tess: One more thing — we saw this pattern twice in the past 6 months (see past incidents). Recommend recurring cadence: weekly dependency resilience review for the next 6 weeks to catch regressions. Who can commit to rotating owner?

miguel: I can take first rotation for next week, then we'll hand off.

kai: I'll do the second rotation.

tess: Perfect. I'll update the remediation tracker spreadsheet and assign these items with clear due dates. I'll post the tracker link here once updated.

ops-bot: INF-4512 updated: owners assigned (raj, emily, miguel, kai), due dates added, linked to DR schedule.

tess: Thanks all. Small ask: keep replies short here when you update status (e.g., "raj: PR merged", "emily: staging deployed"). We'll close the loop in this thread. :memo:
